value.rationale: Lower total-visibility models worst-case maximal greedy outputs, a mathematically motivated complement to known maximum values. A natural three-factor Hamming family exhibits lower number two with upper a+b-2 and has a closed count of every minimum facet; for two binary factors, the complete face/facet polynomials and homotopy type solve a full infinite-family classification. The sharp double-binary boundary and sphere-with-bridges structure add information not supplied by the published scalar maximum or general membership theorem. The contribution is not an arbitrary numerical cutoff.
